Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; reviewed user-supplied created-card scans.

Cards.Name: Fruitless Search
Cards.Text: Reaction: After engaging, if any enemy units are at the current battlefield: Create a 4F/4C/3PH Imperial • Samurai • Duelist • Magistrate Personality on your side there. Remove him from the game after this battle ends.

Cards.Name: Grateful Reward
Cards.Text: Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing Samurai at the current battlefield: Create a 1F Ashigaru • Cavalry Follower and attach it to him. If he is a Paragon, gain 2 Honor and draw a card.

Cards.Name: Sword for Hire
Cards.Text: Limited: Target another player's Personality: Create a 0F/3C/0PH Assassin • Duelist Personality. He duels the targeted Personality. Destroy the duel's loser. After the duel ends, remove the created Personality from the game.

Cards.Name: Crippled Sensei
Cards.Text:
As a Focus Effect: After this duel ends, choose a player who loses 2 Honor.
Reaction: After one of your Personalities is destroyed: Create a Maimed • Retainer Holding with the ability, "Battle/Open: Destroy this card and target a Personality: Straighten him. Rehonor him."
